messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
viscous friction force depends on velocity.
velocity multiplied by a coefficient gives the force.
force also depends on fluid viscosity and area.
area and shape set the effective damping.
damping should be included for a physical pendulum model when energy loss is significant.
significant energy loss makes the pendulum model viscous.
